# Nuevo Foundation contributor guidance

For feature implementation, bug fixes, or a PM delivery brief, load the
`issue-lifecycle` skill in `.github/skills/issue-lifecycle/SKILL.md`. Use it to
record distinct work, keep the change scoped, and close with verifiable evidence.
If the skill cannot be loaded, report that instead of silently skipping tracking.

Planning, explanation, and preview requests stay read-only. Skill selection does
not authorize issue mutations, commits, pushes, merges, or deployments that the
user did not request.

Preserve this repository's conventions and normal check/review requirements.
Use confirmed facts and approved assets for public content. Keep secrets,
unrelated changes, and fabricated claims out of the change.
